coverage.discovery: rg --files --hidden --no-ignore -g '*.lean' with excluded directory components below; untracked and ignored files are included; saved copies (the path rule in path_role: run, check, snapshot and verification folders) are not read or listed, each being bound by its own run's receipt
coverage.symlinks: ripgrep default: directory symlinks are not followed
coverage.declaration_scan: Comment/string-aware, line-start explicit theorem/lemma/def/abbrev/structure/inductive/opaque/axiom/constant declarations. Namespace qualification is a textual hint. Generated constructors/projections/instances and anonymous examples are not enumerated as named declarations.
coverage.validation: Documentary inventory only. No Lean compilation, axiom audit, receipt hash binding or mathematical/ethical correspondence verification is performed. SHA-256 is calculated from every indexed file's actual bytes.
coverage.classification: Path-based documentary roles; working-source is not a claim of accepted, complete, canonical or checked status. A file containing only #print axioms and no inventoried named declarations is an audit-driver.
